project_type: Full-stack monorepo: Python FastAPI backend, React (Vite) frontend, Cloudflare Worker edge proxy
build_system: pnpm workspace monorepo, pip-compile for Python, Docker for backend deployment
test_framework: pytest for backend, vitest for frontend and edge
test_command: JWT_SECRET='test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long' APP_ENV=test python -m pytest apps/backend/ --tb=short -q (backend); pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit (edge); pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit exec tsc --noEmit (frontend)
verification_instructions: 1. Backend: verify Docker image starts and can import main module; 2. Edge: verify tsc --noEmit passes; 3. Frontend: verify tsc --noEmit passes; 4. CI: verify workflow YAML is valid
snapshot_or_generated_files: requirements.txt is generated from requirements.in via pip-compile
setup_instructions: pyenv global 3.11.15; pip install deps from requirements.txt; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access available. Docker available for build verification.
contribution_requirements: No specific CONTRIBUTING.md found. Changes should maintain consistency with existing patterns.
key_patterns: Backend uses Beanie ODM for MongoDB, Upstash REST Redis, pydantic-settings for config. Edge is Cloudflare Worker with KV/R2 bindings. Frontend uses Vite + React with @/ path aliases.
directory_structure: apps/backend/ - Python FastAPI; apps/frontend/ - React SPA; apps/edge/ - Cloudflare Worker; .github/workflows/ - CI/CD; infra/ - infrastructure configs
